description: Single oscillator with seven fixed waveform outputs, running at audio rate or a hundred times slower as an LFO

params.text: Sets the pitch in semitones, fifty-four either side of C4 at 261.63Hz.
Detunes the oscillator by up to three semitones either way, with a squared response.
Attenuates the exponential FM reaching the oscillator, 0% to 100%.
Attenuates the linear FM reaching the oscillator, 0% to 100%, with a squared response.
In analogue the pitch drifts with a slow random slew and the waveforms carry richer harmonics; in digital the COARSE knob snaps to whole semitones and RAMP becomes a reverse sawtooth.
Sets the width of the square wave, 0% to 100%.
Switches the oscillator between audio rate and a rate one hundredth of it.

inputs.text: A rising edge sends the oscillator back to the start of its cycle.
Sets the pitch, twelve semitones per volt.
Frequency-modulates the oscillator linearly through the LIN knob.
Frequency-modulates the oscillator exponentially through the EXP knob.
Widens the square by 10% per volt, added to the PW knob.

outputs.text: The ramp, peaking at 6V; it takes a different curvature in analogue mode and runs as a reverse sawtooth in digital mode.
The square wave, peaking at 6V, its width set by PW.
The sine wave with its negative half removed.
The sine wave with its negative half turned positive.

inputs.0: high above 0.01V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.3:
unipolar · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
